steps.content: Meanwhile, Wynn and Eugene have lost contact with you and are frantic with worry.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Oh no, oh no! We've lost Chief's signal! We should have joined him for the second run instead of letting him go alone. What if there's an emergency and no one's there to help him?
steps.female_content: Oh no, oh no! We've lost Chief's signal! We should have joined her for the second run instead of letting her go alone. What if there's an emergency and no one's there to help her?

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Calm down, Wynn. Have faith in Chief. I've already led a team into the Mania zone. We should have news soon.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: How are things on your end? Have you detected any Mania spikes?

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Okay, I'm calm... I'm calm... Phew... There are intense Mania fluctuations 200 meters southeast of your coordinates. Wait...! Eugene, look! Chief's signal! It's back!
[Black Screen Transition]

You make it out of the hourglass, gasping for air as the illusion collapses. The sand and hourglass are all gone. You're now standing on an Eastside street. Static crackles in your ear as the signal comes back on, Eugene and Wynn's anxious voices coming through your device.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eugene, Wynn, I'm safe for now. Don't worry.

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief! Thank goodness you're okay! Oh, I would've died from guilt had anything happened to you. I never should have persuaded you to try this game...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This isn't the time to feel guilty yet. This Sinner's ability is extremely dangerous. Even I couldn't easily see through the illusions she created. Without the shackles, I wouldn't have been able to even sense the abnormal Mania. Eugene, continue searching for any victims in this area. Don't let anyone fall into another illusion.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Yes, Chief!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This isn't enough. Even if I escaped one illusion, there's no guarantee I won't be pulled into another. Most importantly, we need to capture her in her true form in the real world.
After a moment's consideration, you contact Faye.

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: Chief? Oh, you went to try the game today, didn't you? How was it? Calling to share your thoughts with me?
...Why were both Faye's and Wynn's first reactions to ask about your thoughts? Their similar responses strike you as an odd coincidence, but you don't have time to dig deeper right now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Faye, you never fail to bring me surprises. Though you reassured me many times about this one, I'm afraid you just have a knack for stirring up hornets' nests. This time, we've barged into a Sinner's lair. An S-Class, no less.

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: Wow, Chief... What a coincidence, hahaha... I swear I had no idea there was a Sinner involved when I bought the ticket! Please don't punish me, Chief!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Want to make up for this? Then figure out how to reduce next quarter's Supply Office expenditures.

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: ...Is that all? That's a piece of cake. Leave it to me!
After debriefing Eugene and Wynn, you return to the entrance of Nightwrought.
(Scene change)

Mania has thoroughly wrecked the establishment. Compared to when you first came, it's nothing but ruins now. The place is entirely deserted, but where the lobby once stood, a pitch-black void has appeared out of nowhere. The void looks endless, leading to some unknown destination. Around it, pages swirl in the air, covered with elegant cursive writing.
And deep inside that dark passage, a silhouette stands in the distance.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You look like you've been waiting for me. Isn't this bait a bit obvious, Irrheia? Or did you actually think hiding here would keep you from being discovered?

Under the MBCC's offensive, the Witch has nowhere left to run. Even though she can manipulate the rules in the illusions within a certain range, fighting against a team of pros has proven taxing even for her.

At the center of the chaotic void is Irrheia, surrounded by Mania. You've seen this situation many times before. Her infection is severe and the Mania inside her has gone out of control, contaminating the entire district.

Moreover... you know that Aurum Secretum weapons cause side effects of various degrees in their users. Even if her claim is true that she obtained this Aurum Secretum hourglass from an Outland Sinner, to <color=#fb9259>resonate</color> with it would still drain the user's own power.

Irrheia's breathing seems to weaken by the second, and surprisingly, you barely sense any Mania on her person. It seems the Aurum Secretum hourglass and the notebook have been the true sources of Mania all along. Did you... make a wrong guess? Could the Mania be controlling this Sinner instead of the other way round?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is the Mania controlling you instead of the other way round?
Moreover, even weakened by the recoil from the damaged hourglass, the Witch's aura still permeates the space, restraining the hourglass's power.
Her fragile silhouette is engulfed by the Mania storm, swirling pages cutting into her skin. In that moment, you realize she might be the one truly trapped.
You reach out your hand, but Irrheia is instantly swept away by the Mania storm and vanishes, leaving you alone facing the void.
Is this cunning witch truly in peril, or... could this be part of her script as well?

options: No choice but to face it

steps.content: You step onto the pitch-black path, just like when you first entered this game. After an endless darkness, you find yourself back in the place where you were once imprisoned by Prima and the Clergyman.

Everything has been torn apart in this space. Gravity no longer exists, and the room's furnishings float randomly. In the spatio-temporal fissures, you revisit scenes of all of your "deaths." In the endless loop, you and the others enact different scenarios, yet the ending is always the same.
[Flash scenes of various NPCs going mad]
[Insert CG - Got You]

Staring at the storm, you step closer toward the source of the Mania, your stride steady and resolute. With your thoughts, your face appears in every spatio-temporal fissure, determined, unwavering, clear-eyed, and uncompromising. You stretch out your hand to confront the Mania permeating the air.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "Humans are bundles of desire. We suffer when we don't get what we want, but we tire of it the moment we do." Everyone goes through this same cycle endlessly. The present pain always hurts the most, so we place our hope in the future.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Someone as smart as you must know that our wishes can never be satisfied by mere illusions.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why push the darkest impulses of those oppressed by life to their extremes? Why make yourself the biggest villain in the story?
[Insert CG - Got You]-Hand Close-up
The false images shatter one by one. Your hand reaches into each of the fissures, all aiming at one single target!
It's the symbol of this world's rules, floating above you all along, yet always so elusive. The Aurum Secretum hourglass. You've finally discovered its location!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We've cornered you, a result of your own guidance. What outcome are you hoping for?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is it merely for entertainment? Are you trying to create a worthy opponent who can break your routine as the mastermind...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Or is it redemption? A way to free yourself from Mania?
[Release Shackles] Glass shattering effect with dreamlike elements

This time, the shackles crush the Aurum Secretum hourglass. As the sand scatters, you see the Witch. She raises her head slowly, and surprisingly, countless faces flash over her own, all people you've encountered in Cirrenfold.

The flash of images finally stops, revealing an innocent-looking Prima clutching a notebook in her arms... No, the notebook is oozing with ominous Mania. Or rather, the Mania is trapping her in a tight embrace.

steps.speaker: Prima
steps.content: Help me...
Without the slightest hesitation, you raise your hand again.

options: Attack the Mania script manipulating Prima
Attack Prima, who is the Witch and the culprit

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: End this game of manipulation.
In the light of the shackles, you think you see Prima smile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even now, you're still trying to deceive me!
In the light of the shackles, the Witch, who was feigning tears, reveals a smile.
